title: Youthful Pan-Seared Japanese Fish Kushikatsu
description: Buttery, aerated, festive kushikatsu dish featuring dill, miso-marinate, low-calorie-friendly. A delicious and healthy Japanese-inspired meal from the Kanto region, served in scallop shells.
instructions: Cut the Japanese sea bass fillets into 1-inch pieces.
In a shallow dish, mix together miso paste, mirin, soy sauce, sake, sugar, and rice vinegar to make the marinade.
Add the sea bass pieces to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Prepare the dipping sauce by mixing together equal parts of soy sauce and sake in a small bowl.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of butter.
Dredge the flour-coated sea bass pieces in Panko breadcrumbs, shaking off excess.
Pan-fry the Kushikatsu for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the Kushikatsu to a plate and serve immediately in scallop shells with a side of dipping sauce.
Garnish with chopped dill and serve hot.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a complete meal.
Make sure not to overcrowd the pan, cook in batches if necessary.
